subject: Behavioral Economics
title: FOMO: Fear of Missing Out
description: A fast breakdown of FOMO: Fear of Missing Out for builders.

hook.text: Everyone is posting about a flash sale. You were not planning to buy anything. Twenty minutes later, your cart is full.

buildup.text: FOMO is the anxiety that others are getting benefits you're missing. Social media amplifies it by making others' gains.

discovery.text: Przybylski found FOMO is driven by unmet psychological needs: autonomy, competence, and relatedness.

twist.text: Marketers engineer FOMO deliberately. Live viewer counts, sold-out warnings, and social sharing buttons all trigger.

climax.text: When FOMO strikes, ask: would I buy this if nobody else knew about the deal?

punchline.text: FOMO isn't about missing out. It's about belonging.

quiz.question: What psychological needs drive FOMO according to Przybylski?
